name: Proudhorn the Elder
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Proudhorn the Elder receives visitors atop Thunder Bluff. Tauren honor him as an ancestral spirit and pay respect to the wisdom of those who watch over Mulgore and the Horde.

sections.title: A Spirit of Mulgore
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, Proudhorn the Elder appears high on Thunder Bluff's windblown mesas. Tauren hold their ancestors' voices in the highest regard. They believe ancient leaders and sages remain as spirits, offering guidance and strength to the living.

sections.title: Homage and Ancestral Blessing
sections.body: Travelers who climb Thunder Bluff's heights to honor Elder Proudhorn are welcomed as vital flames of life. In return for their homage, he gives them a Coin of Ancestry, a sign of communion between the enduring past and the living champions who fight for the world's future.

faq.answer: Proudhorn the Elder is an honored tauren ancestral spirit who appears atop Thunder Bluff during the Lunar Festival to receive homage from champions across Azeroth.

faq.q: Where can I find Proudhorn the Elder?
faq.answer: You can find Elder Proudhorn atop Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital on the central mesas overlooking Mulgore's plains.

faq.q: What is the purpose of visiting him?
faq.answer: Visiting Elder Proudhorn lets you honor the spirits of the past during the Lunar Festival. He gives visitors his blessing and a Coin of Ancestry.

faq.q: Can Alliance players visit Elder Proudhorn?
faq.answer: Elder Proudhorn blesses any respectful traveler, but Alliance travelers face great danger in Thunder Bluff from its vigilant guards and Horde defenders.

faq.q: What is a Coin of Ancestry?
faq.answer: A Coin of Ancestry is a ceremonial token granted by ancient spirits during the Lunar Festival. It symbolizes respect and communion between the living and their ancestors.

faq.q: How do the tauren view their elders?
faq.answer: Tauren revere their ancestors as guardians and teachers. Their spirits remain woven into the land, guiding those attuned to the Earth Mother.

angles.text: As a tauren, honoring Elder Proudhorn is a sacred homecoming that renews your bond with the spirits watching over Mulgore.
As a member of the Horde, you are welcome to climb Thunder Bluff and pay homage to this elder at the heart of tauren power.
As a shaman, you can commune with an ancestral elder through a profound rite with the enduring spirit world.
